mapper.select: select c.id, c.product_id productId, p.title productTitle, p.images productImages, c.status, c.last_message_time lastMessageTime, o.id otherUserId, o.nickname otherNickname, o.avatar otherAvatar, (select m.content from message m where m.conversation_id = c.id order by m.id desc limit 1) lastMessage, (select count(*) from message m where m.conversation_id = c.id and m.to_user_id = #{userId} and m.is_read = 0) unreadCount from conversation c left join product p on c.product_id = p.id left join user o on o.id = if(c.buyer_id = #{userId}, c.seller_id, c.buyer_id) where c.buyer_id = #{userId} or c.seller_id = #{userId} order by c.last_message_time desc, c.id desc
